title: ULID Generator
description: Generate and parse ULID (Universally Unique Lexicographically Sortable Identifier)
ulidInfo: ULID (Universally Unique Lexicographically Sortable Identifier) is a 128-bit identifier composed of 48-bit timestamp and 80-bit randomness. Compared to UUID, ULID is sortable, shorter, and more readable. It uses Crockford's Base32 encoding, generating a 26-character string.
